purpose: Post-hoc read-only report extraction of existing V18 training/runtime metadata; not a new experiment or a re-score.

verification_scope.worker_hours_definition: Sum of launch-to-controller-observed-exit durations for one-GPU workers; includes model loading, CPU scoring and shared-resource waits; not CUDA kernel time or exclusive GPU billing.
verification_scope.training_completion_time_definition: Timestamp of existing six_gpu_queue_01 exit receipt; may be seconds after the model wrote its final checkpoint.
verification_scope.numeric_precision: JSON numbers below are parsed from original records; aggregate arithmetic uses Python IEEE-754 binary64. No display rounding is applied.

role_boundary.selection_basis: seeded source-group hashes, never model success or reference values
role_boundary.source_independence_warning: Preserving official splits and distinct task roles is not evidence of complete report-level independence or absence of pretraining contamination.
role_boundary.ABMD_adjudication_source: Named Codex source-grounded research judgment, not a human or another paid DeepSeek return; original V17 invalid binding and hold preserved.

execution_plan.physical_update_count_derivation: 3*298 + 15*(1490-298) = 18774; 3*149 C reverse + 3*149 N = 894. Fifteen logical model histories total 15*1490 = 22350, which is not the physical count.

outer_aggregate.interpretation: Feedback is adaptive one-step virtual-Student stochastic training feedback, not independent development accuracy. invalid_prediction is a known model-output zero reward, not an infrastructure Unknown.

historical_runtime_caveats.V20_CUDA_gate_scope: Four registered paired replay cases on GPU4, bitwise logP and gradient agreement; about 10.5% measured reduction for these cases only, not a whole-run speedup claim.
historical_runtime_caveats.V21_to_V22_evaluation_transition: Original post-training source check blocked on providers.py. V22 accepted only the exact API trust_env=False difference, leaving LocalTorchProvider and remaining evaluation contract unchanged; no Base rerun or Student retraining.
